links.reported_relation: When a user controls 100% of outstanding gHYBR supply, withdraw splits the veNFT into vault portion, user share, and protocol fee.
For the final holder owning 100% of veNFT value, remainingAmount becomes 0 and the withdrawal deterministically reverts with ZW, leaving funds locked.
multiSplit requires each entry strictly positive; a zero remainder reverts the whole withdrawal, so the exit path cannot complete and funds stay locked.
